about: Free sentences from the live walks (scene replies, Courrier letters, Journal entries) through the correction shown under a letter: MissionCorrectionService.correct_submission, the model check with its deterministic rules and gates. Each sentence is answered to a short tu letter from Gus so the corrector has its usual mission context. 'truth.correct' says whether the sentence is right French; 'truth.errors' lists the real errors the correction must catch.
